corrected_content.problem:
Using the method of substitution, find the solution of
$$
\displaystyle \left\{\begin{aligned}-3p + q &=-9 \\ 5p + 4q &=32\end{aligned}\right.
$$.
corrected_content.worked_solution: The first equation gives $q=3p-9$. Substitute into the second equation: $$5p+4(3p-9)=32\implies17p=68\implies p=4.$$ Hence $q=3(4)-9=3$. Substitution into both original equations gives $-9$ and $32$, as required.
